rules: External material may not contribute normative weight.
A textual witness of Tawrat, Zabur, or Injil must be explicitly labelled TEXTUAL_WITNESS and must not be silently equated with the original revelation.
Quranic metadata that is not stated in the Quran text itself is non-normative metadata.
Unknown revelation location remains UNDETERMINED rather than being filled from external chronology.
Every normative result must expose passage provenance.
Textual witnesses may increase grounding confidence only when local text is present and matched.
A textual witness cannot create or reverse moral direction on its own.
If witness evidence conflicts or is ambiguous, increase uncertainty instead of forcing agreement.
